premise.claim: Issue #542: when a member Pod of a Ready RoleInstance goes away because its node failed, the controller only creates a same-name replacement pod; it never recreates the RoleInstance, and because wasInstanceReady() reads the current (now False) condition while hasRecentRestart() requires a previous policy rebuild, shouldRecreateInstance() is permanently disabled for that instance.
premise.evidence: results/premise-base.out — on base fd160cc: deleted member pod is not a trigger (P0-1), Ready gate closed once NotReady (P0-2), stays closed (P0-3). All PASS, i.e. the reported mechanism exists on base.
premise.note: premise tests live in scripts/premise_base_test.go and must be copied into pkg/reconciler/roleinstance/sync/ on a BASE checkout; they also pass on head for the legacy policy (regression guard for 'legacy unchanged').

integration.cmd: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="${KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS:-$(ls -d $HOME/.local/share/kubebuilder-envtest/k8s/1.31.0-linux-amd64 2>/dev/null || bin/setup-envtest use 1.31.0 --bin-dir bin -p path)}" go test ./test/envtest/testcase/restart_policy/ -run TestRestartPolicy -args -ginkgo.focus 'verify559' -ginkgo.json-report="$GINKGO_REPORT"

findings.claim: After a first FromCreation recreation, the Restarting state (in-memory cache + persisted condition) is cleared only when the instance becomes Ready; a second pre-Ready failure must still trigger recreation but is suppressed.
Same as F1, end-to-end against envtest: second pre-Ready failure must recreate the whole group again.
Documents the current broken interplay: stuck Restarting skips backoff AND suppresses recreation. Flip (to fail) means fixed; invert assertions afterwards.
Ignore-annotated Failed pods no longer hold the legacy backoff slow path open (unannounced legacy-policy behavior delta; base counterpart TestVerify559Base_IgnorePodHoldsBackoffOpen passes on base).
A Succeeded pod being deleted currently triggers whole-instance recreation under FromCreation although the KEP lists Succeeded as a non-goal.
Control: pre-Ready Failed pod triggers whole-instance recreation under FromCreation (feature works).
Control: observed desired-member deletion triggers whole-instance recreation under FromCreation (feature works).
Control: legacy policy pre-Ready member deletion only replaces the member (compatibility invariant).
Control: first pre-Ready failure triggers recreation under FromCreation.
Control: legacy policy keeps no-deletion-trigger and Ready-gate behavior on head.
